headlines.text: Rewind to 2023, when Stokely Hathaway wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event in a The Firm Deletion match against The Hardys vs. Bill & Moriarty vs. Jeff Hardy vs. Matt Hardy vs. Hook vs. Isiah Kassidy vs. Big Bill vs. Lee Moriarty vs. Ethan Page, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.43.

Flash back to 2021, when FTR vs. Proud-N-Powerful vs. Cash Wheeler vs. Dax Harwood vs. MJF vs. Shawn Spears vs. Wardlow vs. Ortiz vs. Santana vs. Chris Jericho vs. Sammy Guevara vs. Jake Hager fought it out in a Blood And Guts match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 7.47 ? a strong outing, part of the special Blood and Guts '21 card.
That Wednesday in 2021, Michael Nakazawa made their long-awaited return to AEW television after 13 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: 2023 brought us this moment: Mark Briscoe vs. Preston Vance locked horns for the first time on Rampage, rated 6.20.

Turning the clock back to 2023: it was the first-ever encounter between Lucha Brothers & Vikingo and QTV, setting the tone as the night's opener on Rampage, rated 7.07 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.

That Wednesday in 2021, SCU (Daniels & Kaz) vs. The Varsity Blonds vs. Jurassic Express vs. The Acclaimed met in a Number One Contender on Dynamite, rated 5.51, part of the special Blood and Guts '21 card.
